_comment: The MLX presets compile a drafter for an MLX target. b4-g64: the QAT drafter's MLX conversion (mlx-community/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-assistant-4bit), 4-bit throughout, the lent embedding included; Google's bf16 drafter under it keeps its own weights dense (that stem's overrides). b4-g32: Google's drafter converted at 4-bit g32 (that stem's overrides list each module).
